system.description: You dampen observers' reactions to your activities, making anything you do seem far more tolerable than it should — so long as your actions are not physically threatening and you do not directly interact with the observer. Unlike most lesser Obfuscate powers, Blithe Acceptance remains in effect even if you affect your physical surroundings or act in an obtrusive manner (picking a lock, defusing a bomb, or rappelling down a building all pass unnoticed). Spend a Willpower Trait and two Mental Traits. Any observer who wishes to take exception to (or even take note of) your nonthreatening actions must defeat you in a Mental Challenge in which you win all ties. The Storyteller is the final arbiter of what counts as "nonthreatening."
